question: Which of the following became the first Indian state to give electricity subsidy to farmers through Direct Benefit Transfer in January 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Madhya Pradesh**__.

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Madhya Pradesh has become the first state to give electricity subsidies through Direct Benefit Transfer**__.

 __
 
• **Direct Transfer Benefit **is a scheme of the Government of India, under which the subsidy amount of **subsidy given by the government to the consumer** is directly transferred to his bank account.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Manipur -**

 
 
• It is a northeastern state of India and its capital is** Imphal.**
 
• The original inhabitants of this place are the people of **the Meitei tribe,** who live in the valley area here.
 
• Their language is Meitilon, which is also called** the Manipuri language**.
 
• This language was added to the **Eighth Schedule** of the Constitution of **India in 1992.**​
 
 
 
• **Sikkim -**
 
 
• It is a** mountainous state** of India.
 
• **Gangtok** is its **capital and largest city.**
 
• India's West Bengal state is to its **south**.​
 
 
 
• **Uttarakhand -**
 
 
• It is a state located in** North India **and its** capital is Dehradun.**
 
• It was created on **9 November 2000 **as the **27th** state of the Republic of India.
